summary: Security alert: axios npm supply chain attack occurred March 30 8-11pm ET. Any engineer who ran 'npm install' in app/admin_frontend/ during that window may be compromised. Shared link to hackernews article. Engineers asked to review their systems and do .env cleanup — local env files should not contain secrets. 42 replies, 8 participants. Serious reactions (scream emoji x4).
Admin app deployment pipeline is broken, expected to be back up in 1-2 hours. Scout developer (U0AJ97FAEJD) posted the update.
Deploy to sandbox has been broken for 3 days. Scout developer (U3GK6LM37) flagged this in the channel and linked the broken GitHub Actions workflow for deploy-sandbox-full-stack.yml.

Post-mortem document shared for auto-scaling (attachment) incident. PR #1756 linked. Meeting held with attendees including U06C0AXSZ45, U07PGNRQ65B, U3GK6LM37, U3M7BK2MQ, U06H7LD1PTN, USHUM3HL5, UJHAJER8S, U04M7405DCP. Positive reactions (muscle x2, heart, thanks).

Bedrock embedding model timeout issue identified. Context_builder node hangs indefinitely when Bedrock embedding call doesn't resume. Happened to at least 2 engineers (U06V6PYHVLK and U20T4HP70). Potential production impact flagged. Open question: should there be a timeout? How to handle skill failure on timeout? 10 replies, 4 participants, +1 reactions x3.
Multiple Scout engineers hitting Claude API rate limits. Screenshot shared. 15 replies, 4 participants. Likely impacting developer productivity on Scout AI development.

SCOUT-3883 created: format tool responses to minimize context size without losing meaning. Estimated 40% context reduction. Flagged as important to complete before GA. Change affects tool call renders across ~50 files. Shared by U20T4HP70.

Code owners policy implemented on db and infra folders in Scout repo. Purpose: tighten release rings and enable rollbacks. May slow down some PRs. Engineers can reach out to get permissions or widen the group to all tech leads.

File upload parsing issue in Scout reported via Sales Engineering. File upload working but data parsing needs improvement. Ownership question raised — unclear which team owns file upload. 7 replies, 2 participants.

New engineer (U03NW5PEGAW) joined eng-scout_guild and asked for onboarding help: needs KT videos, help documentation, and AWS access to get started on Scout development. 17 replies, 3 participants actively helping.

Patch release 100.18.1 announced for Monday March 30. Fixes: (1) Calendar and job assignment cards showing raw Salesforce record IDs instead of names (SIT-60128) — regression actively affecting field staff in production. (2) Sentry quota exhaustion — 22,600+ errors in 7 days, >100K events. Fix: disable session replays, add defensive guard in analytics layer, fix ListView crash. Code freeze March 28, release to stores March 30.

Mobile release 100.19.0 timeline announced. Code cutoff completed March 20. Go/No-Go call scheduled April 6, 2026. Admin preview starting around March 25. All teams asked to move tickets to Ready for Release and update fix versions. Release tags also created for 100.20.0 and 100.21.0.

Mobile admin preview for Cityside delayed. Was planned for March 27 but integration permissions issue pushed it to March 30-31. Metallica team reached out to Cityside for permissions. Preview expected a few days for Cityside to install and test through April 2-3.
iOS build 100.19.0 flagged for Snyk security scan. Critical vulnerability issues were previously found in Appvisory report and a fix has been pushed. Scan requested before release proceeds.

Customer feedback: EDRI (Andrea Christiansson) reported serious error handling gaps in project template activation. Vague error messages (e.g. 'cannot read properties of undefined reading field label') forced weeks of manual troubleshooting. A previous support fix failed to resolve the root issue, reducing customer confidence. Similar feedback noted for another customer the same day. Impact: multiple weeks of wasted time for German team. Request: prioritize error handling improvements, better validation, reliable fixes.

Three customers — BT Networks, Mitie, and Telia Towers — reported similar negative sentiment on the same day. Earlier escalation from Dave @ Mitie about multiple patch fixes over the past year. Pattern of customer dissatisfaction with product stability and patch quality.
Upgrade restart decision finalized. Plan reviewed and questions answered. CX Leadership informed. Enterprise customer upgrades restarting. Previously paused, 9.1 pinned release was stable.

SCOUT-4600 (Class 2 Bug): General Agent skips tool calls on data-grounded 'why/explain' queries and returns ungrounded generic responses instead. Assigned to Mike Behan. Status: Backlog. This is a fundamental answer quality issue — agent not using data when it should.
SCOUT-4534 (Class 2 Bug): Mission file upload spins indefinitely and fails with 400 error. Assigned to Yuval Klein. Status: Backlog. Blocks mission workflows that require file input.
SCOUT-4516 (Class 1 Bug): Connector auth failing every time. Assigned to Abe Dolinger. Closed as Configuration Update. This blocked all connector-dependent Scout functionality.

SCOUT-4608: Scout Release 0.4.0 epic created. Associated pre-release tasks all in Backlog: smoke testing (Luke, Nishmi, Akanksha), Playwright automation, Run Evals, Check Grafana Logs, Release Notes, Swagger Doc Tests. Assigned to Luke T Chavez.

SCOUT-4480 and SCOUT-4607: Yuval Klein working on Watch Evals — typed outcome models, evaluation executor, materializer, and first-class evaluation evidence with trace/span/execution-item navigation. Both in Code Review. Class 2 priority.
SIT-60589 (Class 2 Bug): Template Activation Error with deployment status failure. Status: Not Reviewed, unassigned. Second active template activation bug this week alongside SIT-60526.

SIT-59868 (Class 1 Bug): Allocated quantity and total quantity overridden when creating PLA lines on Production Tracking component. Assigned to Amit Gayal. Status: Ready for Release (fix done). Field staff directly impacted.
SIT-59954 (Class 1): Localhost ATS exception found in production iOS builds — security vulnerability. Assigned to gaurav. Status: Ready for Release. Removed from production build.
